name: ros-electron-better-sqlite3
description: Deliberately NOT a pnpm workspace member (see ADR-0009). Installed with npm into its own node_modules so its better-sqlite3 native addon is a physically separate file from the one pnpm hoists for @ros/core and its Vitest suite. rebuild-for-electron.mjs compiles this copy against Electron's ABI; the root/workspace copy is never touched and stays on Node's ABI.
